Generic Types Exported Types

group GENERIC_TYPES_Exported_Types

Enumeration for generic and mesh message status.

Typedefs

typedef uint8_t generic_stat_t

Type alias matching _generic_stat_t to ensure the correct frame format.

typedef uint8_t mesh_msg_stat_t

Type alias matching _mesh_msg_stat_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Enums

enum _generic_stat_t

Status codes for generic models. Use generic_stat_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator GENERIC_STAT_SUCCESS

Operation successful.

enumerator GENERIC_STAT_CANNOT_SET_RANGE_MIN

Cannot set minimum range value.

enumerator GENERIC_STAT_CANNOT_SET_RANGE_MAX

Cannot set maximum range value.
